// @molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/plugin-integrations: public API snapshot.
// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export declare const INTEGRATION_KINDS: readonly ["source", "document_import"];

export interface IntegrationAccountPresentation {
    readonly account_label: string | null;
    readonly [field: string]: unknown;
}

export interface IntegrationBinding {
    readonly source_id: string;
    readonly connection_id: string | null;
    readonly credential_ref: string | null;
    readonly config: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
}

export type IntegrationKind = (typeof INTEGRATION_KINDS)[number];

export declare const OAUTH_CLIENT_AUTHS: readonly ["basic", "post", "none"];

export declare const OAUTH_GRANTS: readonly ["authorization_code", "device"];

export declare const OAUTH_PLATFORM_HEADERS: readonly ["authorization", "proxy-authorization", "cookie", "host", "content-length", "content-type", "transfer-encoding", "connection", "accept", "user-agent", "private-token", "x-figma-token"];

export declare const OAUTH_RESERVED_PARAMETERS: readonly ["client_id", "redirect_uri", "state", "code_challenge", "code_challenge_method", "response_type"];

export declare const OAUTH_SETTING_USES: readonly ["path", "scope", "client_auth", "tenant"];

export type OAuthClientAuth = (typeof OAUTH_CLIENT_AUTHS)[number];

export interface OAuthContextDeclaration extends OAuthTokenRequestDeclaration {
    readonly key: string;
    readonly pick: {
        readonly kind: "ids";
        readonly pointer: string;
    } | {
        readonly kind: "match_setting";
        readonly setting: string;
        readonly match: string;
        readonly take: string;
        readonly pattern: string;
    };
}

export type OAuthGrant = (typeof OAUTH_GRANTS)[number];

export interface OAuthIdentityDeclaration extends Partial<OAuthTokenRequestDeclaration> {
    readonly list?: {
        readonly min_by: string;
    };
    readonly account_id: readonly (readonly OAuthValueSource[])[];
    readonly label: readonly OAuthValueSource[];
    readonly label_prefix?: string;
    readonly keep?: readonly OAuthKeepDeclaration[];
}

export interface OAuthKeepDeclaration {
    readonly key: string;
    readonly pointer: string;
    readonly check?: "tenant" | {
        readonly pattern: string;
    };
    readonly required?: boolean;
}

export interface OAuthSettingDeclaration {
    readonly key: string;
    readonly label: string;
    readonly placeholder?: string;
    readonly required?: boolean;
    readonly default?: string;
    readonly use: OAuthSettingUse;
    readonly pattern?: string;
    readonly enum?: readonly string[];
}

export type OAuthSettingUse = (typeof OAUTH_SETTING_USES)[number];

export interface OAuthTokenRequestDeclaration {
    readonly url: string;
    readonly method?: "GET" | "POST";
    readonly body?: unknown;
    readonly headers?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
    readonly query?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
}

export type OAuthValueSource = `identity:/${string}` | `context:${string}` | `literal:${string}`;

export type PluginAuthMethodDeclaration = {
    readonly kind: "token";
    readonly label: string;
    readonly placeholder?: string;
} | PluginOAuthMethodDeclaration | PluginMcpMethodDeclaration | {
    readonly kind: "cli" | "mcp";
};

export interface PluginConnectionServiceDeclaration {
    readonly service_id: string;
    readonly title: string;
    readonly group_id: ConnectorDirectoryGroupId;
    readonly summary: string;
    readonly auth_kind: ConnectorAuthKind;
    readonly auth: {
        readonly methods: readonly PluginAuthMethodDeclaration[];
    };
    readonly auth_help?: string;
    readonly capabilities: readonly ConnectorCapability[];
    readonly outbound_note?: string;
    readonly setup_links?: readonly ConnectorSetupLink[];
    readonly origins?: readonly string[];
}

export interface PluginIntegrationDeclaration {
    readonly integration_id: string;
    readonly kind: IntegrationKind;
    readonly service_id: string;
    readonly document_source?: string;
    readonly connection_methods?: readonly ConnectorMethodKind[];
}

export interface PluginMcpMethodDeclaration {
    readonly kind: "mcp";
    readonly endpoint: string;
    readonly auth: "oauth" | "bearer" | "either" | "none";
    readonly registration?: "manual";
    readonly endpoint_pattern?: {
        readonly source: string;
        readonly flags: "u" | "iu";
    };
    readonly token_scheme?: "Sentry-Bearer";
}

export interface PluginOAuthMethodDeclaration {
    readonly kind: "oauth";
    readonly grant: OAuthGrant;
    readonly authorize_url?: string;
    readonly token_url: string;
    readonly refresh_url?: string;
    readonly device_authorization_url?: string;
    readonly issuer?: string;
    readonly scopes: readonly string[];
    readonly pkce?: "S256";
    readonly client_auth?: OAuthClientAuth | {
        readonly setting: string;
    };
    readonly token_format?: "form" | "json";
    readonly client_secret?: "required" | "optional";
    readonly parameters?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
    readonly settings?: readonly OAuthSettingDeclaration[];
    readonly identity: OAuthIdentityDeclaration;
    readonly keep?: readonly OAuthKeepDeclaration[];
    readonly context?: readonly OAuthContextDeclaration[];
    readonly quirks?: {
        readonly refresh_redirect_uri?: true;
        readonly omit_token_params?: readonly ("grant_type" | "redirect_uri")[];
        readonly expiry?: "jwt_exp";
    };
    readonly note?: string;
}

export interface SourcePresentation {
    readonly scope_options?: readonly {
        readonly value: string;
        readonly label: string;
    }[];
    readonly conditional_request?: "etag" | "last-modified" | "unvalidated" | "not-fetched";
    readonly home_url?: string | null;
}

export interface SourcePresentationInput {
    readonly cursor?: unknown;
}
